ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: {THING}
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A mage wants a place set aside for working magic: a magic circle, a focal point or an arcane forge.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: The colony has {THING}, or another magic circle, focal point or arcane forge.

wants.reason: {PAWN_nameDef} has the gift, and nowhere in the colony to work it properly.

plain.li: I've been practicing behind the woodpile, and the sparks keep landing in the hay. Could we build {THING}?
Magic wants a quiet, marked place. Right now I work it at the dinner table, between the bread and the salt.
[night] I can't do the long workings in my room. The others hear it through the wall, and it frightens them.
[trait:InnerFire] There are scorch marks on the storeroom floor again. A proper circle would keep the fire where it belongs.
[trait:Druid|trait:TM_Shaman] I can feel the land from anywhere. It's the rest of the work that needs a proper circle.
[trait:Necromancer] The cook won't have my work anywhere near the kitchen, and I can't say I blame them. Give it a place of its own.

warm.li: It wouldn't only be for me. With {THING}, I could do a great deal more for everyone here.

blunt.li: I can't do serious work without {THING}. Build one.

cheerful.li: I've already picked out the spot for {THING}! Right where the light falls in the morning.

gloomy.li: Without {THING}, half of what I know is no use to anyone.

cold.li: With {THING}, I'd be worth twice what I am to this colony. It's a sound use of the stone.

plain.li: It's marked out and ready. I'll start with something small.

warm.li: Thank you. The first working there is for all of us.

cheerful.li: It hums when I stand in the middle of it! That's a good sign.

gloomy.li: Now there's no excuse when it goes wrong.

cold.li: Now I can do real work.

plain.li: The dinner table it is, then.

blunt.li: Don't complain about the scorch marks, then.

gloomy.li: Magic was never going to come first here.

plain.li: Still no circle. The dinner table is getting singed.

warm.li: Whenever there's time for the circle. I know there's a lot to build.
